name: Yushan National Park
story: Yushan National Park covers a total area of 103,121 hectares in Taiwan. It contains more than thirty peaks over 3,000 metres in elevation, featuring many canyons, cliffs, and valleys. The park is home to a large variety of animals and plants.
matters: The national park is an important nesting ground for the Taiwanese population of the mountain hawk-eagle. It also shelters the Formosan black bear, which is an endangered species endemic to Taiwan.
